method.controller: target-conditioned nominal library plus per-step receding-horizon bounded least-squares MPC POC
method.reduced_refinement_model: dimensionless curvature-aware central/secant fit plus conservative Stage3.2 real-TSC Jacobian prior

ip_tracking_change.reason: TSC additional heating; all three explicit Ip tracking tolerances are doubled from the initial Stage3.3 proposal.

ray_capacity_policy: configured campaign capacity; variable-size waves cannot undersize later waves
resume_constraint: Runs created with the same doubled Ip-tracking revision may be resumed. The refinement model revision is upgraded in-place and completed warm-start/probe trajectories are reused.
residual_rl_status: not started; bounded and secondary after a validated causal feedback baseline

validation.existing_probe_manifest_resume_compatibi: implemented and unit-covered through legacy-field inputs; real server resume not run in packaging environment

final_task: robust causal R/Z/Ip control across initial states, targets, hidden dynamics, plant uncertainty, noise, and delay; residual RL remains bounded and secondary

runtime_data_dependencies.reason: Stage3.3 follows the Stage3.2 source manifest chain to recover the validated environment, SVD modes, initial currents, source trajectories, and controller Jacobian.

refinement_debug_fix.triggering_error: Target Z_m2mm has only 1/12 reliable reduced directions
refinement_debug_fix.root_cause: The old postprocessor fitted a raw-physical-unit through-origin line to two probes, treated even curvature as residual, and aborted the entire campaign when fewer than seven directions passed a hard residual threshold. All 168 real-TSC probes had actually succeeded.
changes: fit linear-plus-quadratic real-TSC secants so the central derivative is separated from even curvature
measure signal, curvature, residual, and prior agreement in the dimensionless weighted refinement feature space
regularize weak directions with the previously validated Stage3.2 125x75 real-TSC Jacobian prior
shrink coordinate bounds and increase ridge penalty for low-confidence/source-prior directions
generate exactly collinear feasible probes instead of componentwise clipping reduced directions
isolate a single unbuildable target model instead of crashing all other targets
resume existing 2x-Ip Stage3.3 runs and reuse completed warm-start/probe JSON.GZ files
